assumptions.statement: The submitted overall and key-area polygons are rough provisional envelopes copied from the repository source package.
assumptions.impact: All areas and derived ratios must be recalculated after official redlines are issued.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage status and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land use, footprints, alignments and phasing are urban-design concepts for professional deepening, not approval drawings.

assumptions.statement: A public operating consortium, service-level agreements and annual disclosure process can be established.
assumptions.impact: Stack windows open only after accountable operators, budgets, privacy review and public opt-out procedures are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Six initial personas reveal major access barriers but do not replace engagement with residents, workers, students, visitors and disabled people.
assumptions.impact: Every scenario requires co-design, accessibility testing and a non-digital service path before scaling.
